Our React application is server-rendered, so the full product copy is present in the initial HTML. Search engines and AI assistants can read the headline, the description, and the calls to action without executing any JavaScript at all.

Hydration only attaches interactivity to content that already exists; it does not create the primary text. This is the correct pattern and must not be flagged as a defect.
